summary_1line: Dhritarashtra recounts Krishna’s legendary feats and victories, concluding that the Pandavas are nearly unbeatable with Krishna as their ally.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna rides on Garuda toward Amaravati and seizes the celestial Parijata tree as the heavens watch in alarm.
Krishna hurls the flying city of Saubha down into the sea while warriors watch from the shore.
Krishna and Arjuna stand together on a war chariot, with Krishna as charioteer holding the reins and Arjuna ready with his bow.
